basic_details.job_title: District Court Thrissur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 14 Office Attendant, Computer Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Thrissur District Court has announced a total of 14 temporary vacancies for Computer Assistant / L.D. Typist (7) and Office Attendant (6) posts under advertisement number HC-20/2026. Eligible retired applicants can apply through the prescribed offline process by submitting their applications either directly or by post to the District Judge, District Court Complex, Thrissur before 5:00 PM on 29 October 2026. content_sections.heading: District Court Thrissur Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Computer Assistant / L.D. Typist, Office Attendant
Retired from courts or equivalent/higher government departments

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted either directly or by post to the following address: District Judge, District Court Complex, Thrissur - 680 003 Applications must reach the specified address on or before 29.10.2026 by 5.00 PM. Applications can be submitted in person or sent via post. It is mandatory to include a mobile number in the application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility Condition: Applicants must have retired from courts, from departments equivalent to courts, or from posts in other government departments that are equivalent to or higher than the notified posts. Age Limit: Applicants must not have completed 62 years of age. Employment continues until continuous service reaches 179 days, until the court's functioning ends, or until the individual appointed turns 62 years of age - whichever comes first.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Complete bio-data including mobile number Aadhaar card copy Self-attested copies of certificates proving age, educational qualification, and work experience

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a priority order determined from the list prepared for each post. The applications of eligible candidates will undergo strict scrutiny of their bio-data, qualifications, experience, and service records. Preference will be given to individuals who retired from courts.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are notified under District Court Thrissur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 14 temporary vacancies are notified for Computer Assistant / L.D. Typist and Office Attendant posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 29.10.2026 before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Applicants who have retired from courts, equivalent departments, or higher government department posts are eligible to apply, provided they have not completed 62 years of age.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for Computer Assistant / L.D. Typist?
faq.answer: The notified consolidated pay for Computer Assistant / L.D. Typist is Rs. 23,360/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Office Attendant?
faq.answer: The notified consolidated pay for Office Attendant is Rs. 20,280/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted either directly or by post to the District Judge, District Court Complex, Thrissur - 680 003 along with required document copies and a mandatory mobile number.

faq.question: Q7. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose a complete bio-data with a mobile number, an Aadhaar card copy, and self-attested copies of certificates proving age, qualification, and work experience.

faq.question: Q8. How is the selection conducted for these temporary posts?
faq.answer: Selection is made on a priority basis determined through a thorough scrutiny of applications, qualifications, experience, and service records, giving preference to those who retired from judicial departments.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any upper age limit restriction?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must not have completed 62 years of age. Engagement runs for up to 179 days, until the court's operation concludes, or until the candidate reaches 62 years of age, whichever is earliest.
